title: Kettlebell Push Press
summary: A one-arm overhead press with one kettlebell, driven by a short knee dip, so you can handle more weight than a strict press.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.9 for front delts (main mover): each working set adds 0.9 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.6 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.3 for side delts (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly side delts total.
Library rating 0.3 for traps (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.3 for quads (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.2 for obliques: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Rack one bell at your shoulder and dip your knees slightly.
Drive up with your legs and press the bell overhead in one move.
Lower to the rack under control, then switch arms.

form_cues.cue: Dip straight down. Don't lean forward or to the side.

mistakes.text: Dipping too deep and losing the drive.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
